concepts.prompt: One single isolated modular grassy hill-flank terrain piece for a cozy fantasy meadow, seen in clear 3/4 view from the front and slightly above. Shape: a long, soft wedge-shaped slope, about one and a half times longer than it is deep and half as tall as it is deep: the front rises from ground level in a smooth convex rolling grassy slope to a soft rounded crest along the back; the back face is a plain flat vertical face meant to be hidden against a wall; both short ends taper down smoothly and roundly into the ground, so from the front it reads as a gentle rolling hill shoulder. No straight cliff faces on the front or ends, no undercut, no overhang. Thick lush grass over most of it; near the bottom of the slope a few soft layered terraces of exposed brown soil bank with rounded lips, two or three rounded mossy grey stones half-buried in the slope, one or two small exposed roots and two small round leafy shrubs; no trees. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, hand-painted look, matching the rolling hills in the reference landscapes, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no people, no animals, no buildings. Palette: earth brown #6b5236, meadow grass green #6f9a3c with lighter yellow-green tips, weathered stone grey #8c8778, soft green moss. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat base.

concepts.prompt: Edit the first image (the grassy hill-flank slope tile) and keep its style, grass, soft soil terrace, mossy grey stones and small round shrubs. Change the shape: it must NOT look like a diorama slab. Remove the flat square base plate and remove the vertical brown cut faces on the ends and edges. The front of the piece is a long, smooth, convex rolling grassy slope that feathers out into the ground at a very shallow angle with grass all the way to its thin edge. Both short ends are rounded and taper smoothly down into the ground like the shoulder of a rolling hill, also grassy all the way down. Only the long back side is a plain flat vertical face (it will be hidden against a wall). Proportions: about one and a half times longer than deep, height about half the depth, crest along the back edge. No straight cliff faces on the front or ends, no undercut, no overhang, no trees. Hand-painted Palworld / Animo style matching the rolling hills of the second image. Single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no people, no animals, no buildings. Palette: earth brown #6b5236, meadow grass green #6f9a3c with yellow-green tips, stone grey #8c8778, soft moss. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat underside.

concepts.prompt: Using the grassy hill in the first image as the exact style and material reference (same lush hand-painted grass, same feathered grassy foot that meets the ground at a very shallow angle, same soft terrace lip of brown soil, Palworld / Animo style), draw one single smaller isolated hill-flank piece: an elongated soft grassy hillock that is shaped like HALF of an oval mound cut lengthwise. Seen from the front in 3/4 view: a long, smooth, convex rolling grassy slope rising from a thin grassy feathered edge at ground level up to a soft rounded crest; both short ends curve round and taper down into the ground, grassy all the way down. The cut back side is a plain flat vertical face that is hidden from this view. Proportions: one and a half times longer than deep, height about half the depth. On the front slope: one short soft curved lip of exposed brown soil, two rounded mossy grey stones half-buried, one small exposed root and two small round leafy shrubs. NOT a diorama: no base plate, no slab, no brown band around the bottom, no visible cut faces from the front or the ends. No straight edges on the front or ends, no undercut, no trees. Single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no people, no animals, no buildings. Palette: earth brown #6b5236, meadow grass green #6f9a3c with yellow-green tips, stone grey #8c8778, soft moss. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere.

Crest is asymmetric, highest toward +X (about x 6 m). Matches burrow_hill_mound in texture and palette.
